title: Concrete Mixer enters Maintenance with 720-minute buffer after rental end
gherkin:
Given a Concrete Mixer equipment is in Active rental status
When the rental end date is reached
Then the system shall transition the equipment to Maintenance status
And the system shall set a 720-minute post-rent buffer period
And the equipment shall remain in Maintenance status for exactly 720 minutes
rationale: Concrete Mixers are explicitly specified to require a 12-hour (720-minute) maintenance window instead of the standard 2-hour rule. This test verifies the category-specific buffer duration is correctly applied upon automatic rental completion.
usedContextItems: Concrete Mixers require 12-hour (720 minute) maintenance window instead of standard 2-hour rule|System transitions equipment from Maintenance status back to Available after category-specific buffer elapses

Date: 2026-02-20 14:00
Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)
